notes_for_editor: Only one list line (GA269) supports this record. Its only tag is 'usgs' and it has no register number, so nothing confirms it is a documented fire lookout rather than another tower type. No build, design, staffing, height or current-status source was found; two searches (Wrightsboro, Columbia County) returned nothing about it. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Georgia lists (both cached and checked). The record's elevation of 139.3 m equals 457 ft, so the list's elevation column is in feet. A search snippet for the list page says names for towers 73 and above are the author's own; the cached copy does not carry that line, so it is not relied on. If it is true, the name 'wrightsboro' is a label, not an official name. Possible duplicate of us-ga-wrightsboro-gfc, about 436 m away by the list's coordinates.
